posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Seiya Suzuki over slides 3B trying to tag up on Bregman's fly out to CF and he's easily out. He might've been out anyways on the tag, but it's a brutal sequence for the Cubs to start the 10th against the Brewers.
posts.jp: 鈴木誠也が3塁走者のタッチアップでスライディングし、アウト。タッチプレーでもアウトだったかもだが、10回表先制のカブスにとってつらい展開。

posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: If Ohtani is the corresponding move and De Paula’s coming up to DH, then the defense point is moot. Ease him into the Majors by letting him do what he does best — hit.
posts.jp: 大谷翔平が対応策で、デ・パウラがDH要員として昇格なら、守備問題は関係ない。彼が得意な打つことをさせて、メジャーに慣れさせよう。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Bryce Harper has now lost 9 of his 14 challenges in the first innings of games. He's challenged more first-inning calls as a batter than 18 *teams* have.

reply_texts.text: And he knows he's hamstringing the rest of the team by losing all these early challenges. It's the most selfish thing he does in a baseball field
reply_texts.author: kbeatt.com

reply_texts.text: I honestly don’t get it. There weren’t even base runners.
reply_texts.author: otho32.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: As a long time Nats fan this surprises me not in the least.
reply_texts.author: stephenlg.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Just stop, Bryce. You're bad at that LOL
reply_texts.author: donnavox.bsky.social

posts.jp: ブライス・ハーパーは初回の判定に9回異議を唱えて失敗。初回の判定に異議を唱えた回数は18球団以上。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: The Guardians lost, so the #BlueJays remain 1.0 game back. If anyone wants to go to the postseason, the third AL Wild Card spot is kind of just sitting there.

reply_texts.text: The least hardest push ever seen in the AL
reply_texts.author: gotchurnosvader.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: You even get to play a team that will likely have a worse record than the 1st or 2nd wildcard teams! Anyone?
reply_texts.author: davethecamel.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I'm sure the White Sox will eventually be fighting for it too; there a non zero chance the Jays will finish with more wins than the central and the west champs which is insane
reply_texts.author: johnquissy.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Sure wish the jays wanted that spot
reply_texts.author: northbaymoe.bsky.social

posts.jp: ガーディアンズ敗北でブルージェイズが1.0ゲーム差。ポストシーズン進出を目指すなら、ALワイルドカード3番手枠が空いてる。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Phillies were down 4-0, 6-4 and now lead, 11-6. Braves and Cubs both down big, too. Interesting.
posts.jp: フィリーズは0-4から4-6、今は6-11リード。ブレーブスとカブスも大きく負けている。興味深い展開。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Cubs lose to the Brewers, 4-3, in 10 innings after being an out away from winning the game.

reply_texts.text: The last 2 weeks have been infuriating. The most critical part of their season and they can hold a lead unless it’s double digits.
reply_texts.author: ctatak.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I have no idea what you do if you’re Counsell at this point. Not one reliable arm in the pen.
reply_texts.author: peanuteminem.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Stop me if you heard this one before
reply_texts.author: leib.bsky.social

posts.jp: カブスはブルワーズに10回延長戦で4-3で敗北。あと1アウトで勝利という局面で。
